origem: Gerada com a ferramenta imagegen integrada do Codex, para os temas do EDY CRM em 05/10/2026.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium dark theme full viewport decorative background for EDY CRM, landscape 16:9, no interface. Create an elegant cinematic macro photograph of fine silky smoke slowly curling in a dark graphite atmosphere. Organic layered wisps moving in multiple gentle directions, charcoal nearly black base, muted slate and deep blue highlights with silver soft edges, restrained volumetric depth. Quiet central regions to support white dashboard text behind almost transparent glass. Smoke should be visibly beautiful and have flowing depth, neither invisible on black nor bright fog. Soft side lighting and fine photographic tonal detail, exceptionally refined and calm. Edge to edge smoke only, no objects, no people, no flames, no particles, no text or logos, no interface. Not a nebula, not a colorful galaxy, not a flat gradient. Composition must work cropped for desktop and portrait mobile; provide continuous smoke texture at all edges so a slowly moving camera remains natural.
transformacao: Codificação WebP qualidade 91; composição e dimensões preservadas.
